decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink mix is far from the firm's core waste-to-energy and engineering focus, and with no website presence after 2019 it is the most likely candidate to be cut.
The modular plant extensions support the core waste-to-energy platform and add value to installed systems, although they were only ever mentioned rather than featured.
WASTX Oil is a flagship decentralized solution to a major global waste-oil problem and fits the firm's strategic direction squarely.
The plastic-to-fuel plant is a flagship product addressing strong demand around plastic waste, so the firm will likely keep developing and deploying it despite technical and market risks.
